N005 助→男 Q Help versus male (1419990); 助すけ also colloquial woman (1344370), not exclusively helper.

N007 努→女 Q Effort (1240820) versus woman (1344930); component resemblance proves no semantic identity.
N008 努→助 Q Striving versus aid; trying to help does not make 1240820 mean rescue/success.
N009 努→動 Q Effort versus motion/action; mental effort need not move, action need not assert striving.
N010 労→学 Q Labor/hardship versus study (1560210/1955900); academic labor overlaps, no manual-only partition.
N011 労→助 Q ONLY labor/hardship versus aid. 労る care/nursing (1560240) directly overlaps help (1344410); ordinary negative safety withheld despite different titles.
N012 労→男 Q Labor/trouble versus male; care and 労き illness retained. Labor is not male-only.
N013 務→勝 Q Role (2872052) versus victory/superiority; competitive duty does not itself mean winning.
N014 務→助 Q Duty versus aid; 助手 is a role, aid can be a duty. Initial focus distinction only.
N015 務→野 Q Duties versus field; 野や private/non-governmental (2868256) is not absence of duties.
N016 勝→服 Q Win/excel versus clothing (1500940); obedience/medicine, archaic 服ぶく mourning (2245830) retained.
N017 勝→助 Q Victory versus aid/rescue; helping a side win does not entail victory.
N018 勝→月 Q Victory versus moon/month (1255430); 月げつ Monday/がつ suffix retained. No moon-origin inference.
N019 勤→勝 Q Employment/diligence versus victory; 勤しむ effort (2087880) does not guarantee success.
N020 勤→動 Q ONLY employment/diligence versus motion. 動く operate/work (1451210 sense 2) is genuine work overlap; no ordinary-negative/reverse approval.
N021 勤→男 Q Work/diligence versus male; 1419990/alternate 男 readings do not restrict service to men.

L003 support: effort not success; rare 勉める (1240820), 勤しむ effort (2087880); introductory focuses, not universal partitions.
L004 support: six kun; special-suru 労する not native-origin evidence. 労きいたずき: archaic pain/trouble plus illness, no 労ずき. ねぎら reference-only; つかれる attested, no recommended 労れる. 労う/労る transitive godan, kana/status qualifications; labor not manual-only.
L005 support: transitive ichidan role, administrative 事務, shared 務まる/勤まる, 務め/勤め; list not universal. Classical 力19 versus Nelson 矛110.
L006 support: five kun; godan-tsu 勝つ, 勝った/勝って, opponent/contest に; godan 勝る versus rare ichidan 勝れる. がち not all negative. Classical 力19 versus Nelson 肉130.

A007 support: employment/service/diligence, ゴン example, retained suffix; not equal frequency.

NAV4 support: words\事務所.md→務; words\公務員.md→務; words\勝つ.md→勝; words\勤める.md→勤. Existing standalone-glyph link wrappers only; text/metadata/examples unchanged. No whole-stem/compound splitting, semantic word amendment, source correction or new directed guard.
